data.summary: The independent validation of the CR‑002 Random‑forest PD challenger benchmarked against the champion model is presented. Performance indicators show strong discrimination with Gini — train {{m:run_45ac60:gini.train}}, Gini — test {{m:run_45ac60:gini.test}}, Gini — out‑of‑time (simulated) {{m:run_45ac60:gini.oot}}, KS — out‑of‑time {{m:run_45ac60:ks.oot}}, AUC — hold‑out {{m:run_45ac60:auc.holdout}}, Brier score — hold‑out {{m:run_45ac60:brier.holdout}}, Predicted × observed — hold‑out {{m:run_45ac60:calibration_ratio.holdout}}, Observed outcome rate — hold‑out {{m:run_45ac60:bad_rate.holdout}}, Approval rate at coded cutoff {{m:run_45ac60:approval_rate.holdout}}, Champion Gini — hold‑out {{m:run_45ac60:gini.champion.holdout}} and Challenger Gini — hold‑out {{m:run_45ac60:gini.challenger.holdout}}. The validation identified {{m:run_45ac60:findings.high}} high‑severity finding, {{m:run_45ac60:findings.medium}} medium‑severity findings and a total of {{m:run_45ac60:findings.total}} findings. Key issues include a high‑severity concern that the challenger was trained and assessed on the same rows, medium‑severity concerns about approval‑rate disparity by age band and direct use of age and personal status/sex, and a low‑severity hardcoded path issue. Overall rating: Requires remediation before continued use.
